name: save_load_bedroom_doors
chapter: A quicksave and quickload in l3_main_bedroom continue the game exactly (OU-SAV-001)
note: The World's state one tick after the save equals the state one tick after the load. The bedroom doors 4526 and 4376 (ma_uo_bedroom_door) each have two colliders (the leaf on its slide and the ring hinged to it, with different transforms); World::stateParts named both "dynamic <uid>", and save.restored pairs parts by name, so the leaf's part was compared with the ring's: a false difference (both transforms were bit-identical after the load). The parts now carry their ordinal among the object's colliders ("dynamic 4526 0", "dynamic 4526 1").
